comments.text: Re New Caledonia: you should do a video on the developments there... this year Macron agreed to a form of independence, where the country becomes a seperate country while remaining under French souvereignty. They'd get their own passports, while also remaining French citizens, full self governance, apart from a deal about the mines, which would have to sell through France... That was ratified by the New Caledonian parliament, but I have not heard whether the French parliament has ratified it... and given the Assemblée voted yes for Corsican autonomy, but the Senate voted no... I would not be surprised if the French senate voted it down...
